tickets.description: Mobile app sync issues are causing data discrepancies between desktop and mobile views. Changes made on desktop are not appearing on mobile for 14 hours. Our field customer success team relies on mobile access and this delay is causing missed updates.

tickets.subject: Workflow automation triggers firing incorrectly
tickets.description: Workflow automation triggers are firing incorrectly since the last platform update. Specifically, the assignment workflow is triggering on the wrong conditions. This has caused 408 incorrect assignments in the past 1 days.

tickets.subject: API rate limiting affecting automation scripts
tickets.description: API rate limiting is affecting our automation scripts. We're being throttled at 134 requests/minute but our contract specifies 1472 requests/minute. This is blocking our batch processing which requires approximately 727 requests per run.

tickets.subject: Two-factor authentication setup failing
tickets.description: Two-factor authentication setup is failing for 16 users. The QR code generation returns a blank image and the manual entry code is rejected by Google Authenticator. These users are locked out of the platform since we enabled mandatory 2FA last week.

tickets.subject: SSO configuration not working with Okta
tickets.description: Our team is unable to configure SSO with Google Workspace. We've followed the documentation but receiving 'SAML assertion invalid' error during the authentication step. This is blocking 57 users from accessing the platform. We need this resolved before our company-wide rollout.

tickets.subject: API endpoint returning 500 errors intermittently
tickets.description: We're experiencing intermittent 500 errors when calling the /v2/data endpoint. This started approximately 3 days ago and is affecting our production workflows. Our team has verified that our request payloads are valid. Error ID: ERR-e72b4fa7. Please investigate urgently as this is blocking our data pipeline.

tickets.subject: Database query performance degradation noticed
tickets.description: Dashboard load times have increased significantly over the past 3 weeks. Pages that used to load in under 2 seconds are now taking 15 seconds. This is especially problematic for our engineering team who rely on real-time data. We've cleared browser cache and tested across multiple browsers with the same result.

tickets.subject: Role-based access controls not inherited properly
tickets.description: Role-based access controls are not being inherited properly across our workspace hierarchy. Users assigned the 'Manager' role can not access their designated areas. This is a security concern affecting 42 users.

emails.body:

Best

emails.subject: Implementation timeline concerns
emails.body:
Hi,

We're in week 5 of our implementation and running into some challenges:

1. The data migration from HubSpot is taking longer than expected - 1899 records failed validation
2. Our customer success team needs additional training on workflow automation
3. The SSO configuration with OneLogin isn't matching the documentation

We may need to push our go-live date from 2025-12-01 to 2025-12-12. Can we schedule a call to discuss an updated timeline?

Thanks

emails.subject: Training material request for new users
emails.body:
Hi team,

I want to be transparent - our onboarding experience hasn't been as smooth as we hoped. A few key issues:

1. Our dedicated onboarding specialist has been unresponsive for 5 days
2. The implementation plan doesn't account for our HIPAA requirements
3. 2 of 7 planned integrations are still not configured

We chose your platform because of its reputation, but the onboarding process is making us question that decision. We need a revised plan and more dedicated support.

Regards

emails.subject: Go-live date may need to be pushed
emails.body:
Hello,

Our team is struggling with the initial setup and could use more hands-on support. Specifically:

- Custom field mapping for our finance workflow is confusing
- 20 of our 70 users have reported difficulty with the interface
- The API documentation for automated alerts is unclear

Can we get 4 additional training sessions scheduled? We also need the onboarding guide updated to reflect our custom configuration.

Appreciate the help

emails.subject: Data migration issues - help needed
emails.body:

We're in week 5 of our implementation and running into some challenges:

1. The data migration from legacy system is taking longer than expected - 911 records failed validation
2. Our customer success team needs additional training on predictive modeling
3. The SSO configuration with OneLogin isn't matching the documentation

We may need to push our go-live date from 2026-03-15 to 2026-04-05. Can we schedule a call to discuss an updated timeline?

Thanks
